name: Teach With Retrieval Practice
summary: Teach toward a real mission using short lessons, retrieval, feedback, and records.
description: Design a stateful learning sequence grounded in the learner’s mission, prior knowledge, trusted sources, retrieval practice, feedback, and spaced application. Use when the user wants to learn a skill over multiple sessions.
refuses: It does not equate passive reading or answer recognition with durable learning.
It does not infer broad ability from one response or use manipulative grading.
It does not persist personal learning records without explicit consent.
